resources.string: Remove sunglasses or anything else that covers your face before setup.
Remove sunglasses or anything else that covers your face before setup.
Looking at your phone may unlock it. Someone who looks very similar to you may also be able to unlock it.
Keep your eyes open and look at the screen while unlocking.
Face unlock may be less secure than a strong PIN, pattern, or password.
Your face data is stored securely on this device and is not uploaded.
You can delete your face data at any time in Settings.
